title: Natural Products Inhibit Bacterial Growth and Modulate Quorum-Sensing Systems Las and Rhl in Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14.
authors: Martinez-Rodriguez, Oswaldo Pablo; Garcia-Contreras, Rodolfo; Aguayo-Ortiz, Rodrigo; Yeverino, Itzel Rubi; Fajardo-Hernandez, Carlos A; Patino, Albert D; Hernandez Perez, Hugo A; Hernandez-Garnica, Mariel; Figueroa, Mario
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物抑制铜绿假单胞菌群体感应系统，虽涉及LasR/RhlR蛋白与配体的分子对接和动力学模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无直接关联。
abstract: Quorum sensing (QS) is a bacterial cell communication system in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, which regulates the production of several virulence factors, including pyocyanin, exoproteases, and biofilm formation. Natural products (NPs) have demonstrated their ability to control QS in different bacteria. This work evaluated the antimicrobial and anti-QS potential of a small library of NPs from Mexican biodiversity against P. aeruginosa PA14. Alternariol 4-methyl ether (12), iridoskyrin (17), and 5,8-epi-dioxyergosta-6,9(11),22-trien-3-ol (39) showed the most potent antimicrobial activity at both test concentrations. Regarding anti-QS activity, fuscin (13), neosartorin (18), 8'-hydroxy zearalenone (21), penicillic acid (26), 5,6-dehydroxypenicillic acid (27), pitholide B (36), and citrinin (38) inhibited pyocyanin production, exoproteases activity, and biofilm formation at the lowest concentration without significantly altering growth. Subsequently, in silico studies of deep-learning molecular docking and molecular dynamics indicated the putative mechanism of action of these compounds through their binding to the ligand-binding domains of LasR and RhlR, target proteins that control QS systems. These results demonstrate that NPs, such as pitholide B (36) and citrinin (38), are potential candidates against P. aeruginosa.
abstract_zh: 群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）是铜绿假单胞菌（*Pseudomonas aeruginosa*）中的一种细菌细胞通讯系统，它调控多种毒力因子的产生，包括绿脓菌素、胞外蛋白酶以及生物膜形成。天然产物（natural products, NPs）已显示出在不同细菌中控制QS的能力。本研究评估了来自墨西哥生物多样性的一个小型天然产物库对铜绿假单胞菌PA14的抗菌和抗QS潜力。Alternariol 4-methyl ether (12)、iridoskyrin (17) 和 5,8-epi-dioxyergosta-6,9(11),22-trien-3-ol (39) 在两种测试浓度下均表现出最强的抗菌活性。在抗QS活性方面，fuscin (13)、neosartorin (18)、8'-hydroxy zearalenone (21)、penicillic acid (26)、5,6-dehydroxypenicillic acid (27)、pitholide B (36) 和 citrinin (38) 在最低浓度下抑制了绿脓菌素产生、胞外蛋白酶活性和生物膜形成，且未显著影响生长。随后，深度学习分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）的计算机模拟研究揭示了这些化合物通过与控制QS系统的靶蛋白LasR和RhlR的配体结合域结合而发挥作用的推定机制。这些结果表明，天然产物如pitholide B (36) 和 citrinin (38) 是对抗铜绿假单胞菌的潜在候选物。
